general_information.Description: This course provides essential knowledge and practical skills to apply Artificial Intelligence in optimizing communication strategies in data-rich environments. Students will learn to collect, organize, and analyze structured and unstructured data using generative AI tools and prompt engineering techniques. The course emphasizes extracting actionable insights, visualizing data, and developing custom GPT-based assistants to support analytical and communication tasks. Ethical considerations and best practices in AI-assisted analysis are also addressed, preparing students to implement data-driven, AI-enhanced strategies across diverse communication contexts.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 4. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 5. Communicate and discuss in forum 6. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional) 7. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Theoretical Exam (TE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE + Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

description: This course provides essential knowledge and practical skills to apply Artificial Intelligence in optimizing communication strategies in data-rich environments. Students will learn to collect, organize, and analyze structured and unstructured data using generative AI tools and prompt engineering techniques. The course emphasizes extracting actionable insights, visualizing data, and developing custom GPT-based assistants to support analytical and communication tasks. Ethical considerations and best practices in AI-assisted analysis are also addressed, preparing students to implement data-driven, AI-enhanced strategies across diverse communication contexts.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Integrate generative AI into data analysis workflows by selecting appropriate tools, optimizing prompt strategies, and ensuring responsible and ethical use.
Develop effective prompts to generate accurate, context-specific outputs for AI-powered communication and analytical tasks.
Design customized generative AI assistants using the OpenAI platform to meet specific use case requirements.
Apply prompt engineering and problem framing to use generative AI ethically, reliably, and creatively.
Demonstrate autonomous learning and lifelong learning skills to adapt to rapid technological and societal changes.
